metadata.question: Were there more active fire counts in Punjab than Haryana on November 8, 2024?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use FIRMS (Fire Information for Resource Management System) dataset for active fire detection - Collection: "FIRMS" from MODIS or VIIRS - Date: November 8, 2024 - Location: Two regions - Punjab and Haryana states in India 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for fire data - Need to filter by confidence level if available - The question is specifically about fire counts 3. Logic: - Count fire pixels in Punjab geometry - Count fire pixels in Haryana geometry - Compare the counts - Valid zero (0 fires) is different from no data (C1) or calculation failure (C3) - If Punjab fires > Haryana fires: Answer A (Yes) - If Punjab fires <= Haryana fires: Answer B (No) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometries for Punjab and Haryana const punjab = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level1') .filter(ee.Filter.and( ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'India'), ee.Filter.eq('ADM1_NAME', 'Punjab') )); const haryana = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level1') .filter(ee.Filter.and( ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'India'), ee.Filter.eq('ADM1_NAME', 'Haryana') )); // 2. Load VIIRS active fire data for November 8, 2024 const fireData = ee.ImageCollection('FIRMS') .filterDate('2024-11-08', '2024-11-09'); const fireSize = fireData.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Fire collection size: ${fireSize}`); if (fireSize === 0) { console.log("No fire data available for November 8, 2024."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Get fire image const fireImage = fireData.mosaic(); // 4. Count fires in Punjab const punjabGeom = punjab.geometry(); const punjabStats = fireImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: punjabGeom, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const punjabCount = punjabStats.get('T21').getInfo(); // 5. Count fires in Haryana const haryanaGeom = haryana.geometry(); const haryanaStats = fireImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: haryanaGeom, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const haryanaCount = haryanaStats.get('T21').getInfo(); // 6. Validation and output if (punjabCount === null || haryanaCount === null) { console.log("Calculation failed - null values returned."); console.log("C3"); return; } console.log(`Punjab fire count: ${punjabCount}`); console.log(`Haryana fire count: ${haryanaCount}`); // 7. Final answer if (punjabCount > haryanaCount) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
